class.name: NNBTRepeater
class.brief_description: Repeats its child a fixed number of times (or indefinitely) until it completes or fails.
class.description: Runs its child until it succeeds [member repeat_times] times (returning [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] in between), then completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]. If the child returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], the repeater fails immediately. Set [member repeat_times] to [code]-1[/code] to loop indefinitely, or wrap this node in [NNBTRunOnce] if it should not start over on subsequent tree runs. To loop until a specific status is returned, use [NNBTRepeatUntil] or [NNBTUntilFail].

method.name: get_times_repeated
method.description: Returns the number of successful repetitions completed in the current run.

members.member: Number of child successes required to finish. Set to [code]-1[/code] to repeat indefinitely, or [code]0[/code] to succeed immediately without ticking the child.
